note: Two old, non-comparable, non-official guesses -- not a range with a 'true' value somewhere inside it, and not two points on a trend. Shown side by side, never averaged or blended into one number, so neither is misread as more authoritative than the other. SC/ST shares used for the residual are the exact 2011 Census figures (16.63% SC, 8.61% ST), not the UN-denominator-adjusted per-year projection used elsewhere -- this is a single point-in-time illustration, not part of the year-by-year series.
